data.content: Find the 10 most frequent multiple risk drivers

To make sure I pull the right thing: do you want
- the 10 most frequent co-occurring risk driver pairs (i.e., combinations of substances that are simultaneously IS_DRIVER at the same site and time), or
- the 10 individual substances that most frequently act as risk drivers across all site-times?

Also, do you want any filters (species, years, regions)?
